# authors heading pluralizes (Author -> Authors) and each author
# renders as its own <p> inside quarto-title-meta-contents.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "div.quarto-title-meta div.quarto-title-meta-contents > p",
            "div.quarto-title-meta p.date",
          ]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            'quarto-title-meta-heading">Authors<',
            "<p>Amelia Earhart</p>",
            "<p>Bill Malone</p>",
          ]
        - ['quarto-title-meta-heading">Author<']
